main_measure.name: t of OLS slope of excess 5-bar forward return on up_shock post_pipeline_value (non-overlapping grid)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject if slope t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-bar return on grid bars with forecast >= 10 is above 0

decided_by: Slope t is 2 or more and the mean excess return on grid bars with forecast >= 10 is above 0 (confirm rule).
reading: The coin's mean 5-bar return is the mean of its grid forward returns pooled over all its windows, the regression is one pooled OLS over all coins' grid bars with the slope t = slope / its standard error, grid bars without a full 5-bar forward return inside the window are dropped, and the plan's 'fewer cases' rule is reported as not observable per the workflow.
